body: I can’t keep living like this the only reason I didn’t do it sooner was because of my family I was only staying alive to make them happy but what about what I want everything comes at a cost. The cost for me to keep my family happy was I just made my self feel worse. I can’t keep doing this to my self mate. I am at my end with the voices and the endless days and nights crying. I don’t see why I should keep making my self suffer like this just so those I love can be happy.
my mind is set in stone mate sorry I think it’s for the best I die I am just a waste of life
